findings: Processed current NANPA-valid shard-C NPAs 248, 251, and 254 in numeric order after completed 203/206/209/212/215/218/224/227/239.
Retained 6 public organizations: Fifth Estate; Mobile Bay DSA; Wade in the Water; Waco Mutual Aid; Killeen Creators; and S.C.R.A.P. Collective.

Fifth Estate is a current explicit anarchist organization by first-party self-description. The remaining records are socialist, mutual-aid, social-justice, food-security, or environmental/community adjacent and are not relabeled anarchist absent explicit evidence.

Mobile Bay DSA's current public Linktree exposes at least five public social/community endpoints plus a free-to-join Discord server; Waco Mutual Aid has a public Instagram link in recent local reporting; Killeen Creators exposes a public Facebook feed.
All six exact organization names returned no repository code-search matches before packet creation.
data.method: Authoritative NANPA membership gate; literal NPA searches plus locality-derived public-web searches; current-status verification; repository dedupe search; canonical StarIntel packet materialization.
